decisions.reason: The necessary cross-Requirement effect is already fully represented by the candidate's message-24 MODIFY, including both the user-fee-only conclusion and the government evidence standard.
The conclusion that user fees alone are insufficient does not change the provisional debt/equity mix, interest rate, tranche structure, or mezzanine treatment.
The source decision establishes the required scenario conclusion but does not alter the debt schedule or DSCR output requirement.
The required conclusion about user-fee viability does not change the integrated three-statement model structure.
The source does not add, remove, or change any sensitivity-analysis dimension or method.
The source reinforces why an availability payment is necessary but does not change its established DSCR and equity-IRR sizing criteria.
The source does not change the requirement to calculate equity IRR or its established target range.
The required user-fee scenario conclusion does not alter tax treatment, CCA classes, tax-shield modeling, or equity-return effects.
The source does not revise the accepted operating-cost basis, network scope, assumption status, or exclusion of the Appendix opex figure.
The source conclusion does not change the twelve-site network, authoritative site list, typologies, or treatment of missing site-level details.
The source does not resolve or change the AUD model currency, 2031 price base, or the existing currency ambiguity concerning the CAD opex input.
Showing that aggregate user fees cannot make the project viable does not require changing the listed revenue streams or their separate modeling method.
